slides.title: Alignment beats authority.
slides.sub: How I align stakeholders across 100+ markets without line authority.

slides.title: Three moves I use
items: Agree on the value proposition before anyone argues about features.
Make every trade-off visible: who gains, who pays, what we skip.
Put something real in front of stakeholders as early as possible.
slides.punch: Opinions shrink when evidence shows up.

slides.title: Priority lists or one reference?
slides.before: Every market brings its own priority list to the roadmap.
slides.after: One shared value proposition becomes the reference for every trade-off.

slides.text: Without line authority, clarity is the only authority you have.

slides.title: Alignment is something you design, not a meeting you schedule.
slides.sub: In banking, health and energy, a misaligned decision costs more than a slow one.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
